title: Auth — Passkey Revoke (finish)
description: Submit the user-verification assertion that completes a passkey revocation. On success the auth service unbinds the credential named at start. The payload carries no target — the revocationId is bound to it server-side.

revocationId.description: The revocationId issued by the matching auth/passkey/revoke/start response. Echoed verbatim.

uvCredential.description: AuthenticatorAssertionResponse as returned by navigator.credentials.get over the uvOptions from start. Binary fields base64url-encoded.

Response.title: Auth Passkey Revoke Finish — response payload
Response.description: Acknowledgement of the removed credential. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/auth/passkey/revoke/finish/0.2#response.

credentialId.description: The credential that was removed. Echoed from the server-side binding rather than from the request, so the producer can confirm the ceremony destroyed what they intended.

subject.description: New in 0.2. The VID the revoked credential was bound to.

purpose.description: New in 0.2. What the revoked credential authenticated. `remaining` counts the subject's credentials of this purpose.

remaining.description: How many credentials of the revoked credential's purpose the subject still has. For a session credential never zero — the last-credential guard guarantees it; for a step-up credential it may be zero. Present so whoever just pruned an estate knows what is left without a second round-trip.
